'''Ardia Terrsyn''' a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as an actress around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. She acquired a taste for [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], after playing it while researching a role in a [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] about a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] criminal family. In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], she later traveled to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], to attend the launch of the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]''.
